SanadIntegration.meta_description: Live SANAD SSO integration details for MoDEE SignFlow.
SanadIntegration.title: SANAD SSO
SanadIntegration.description: Jordan digital identity authentication through MoDEE SignFlow. This module is live and can start an SSO session from this application.

flow_steps.authorize: Redirect the user to SignFlow authorize with client id, redirect URI, state, and PKCE challenge.
flow_steps.callback: SignFlow returns an authorization code to the registered callback URI.
flow_steps.token: Exchange the code and PKCE verifier at the GSB token endpoint.
flow_steps.userinfo: Load national ID, email, and mobile from the user info endpoint.
flow_steps.session: Store an encrypted application session cookie and revoke the SignFlow token on logout.

SanadIntegration.connect_description: Start SANAD SSO to verify identity and create a local session.

PlannedIntegration.body: This service module is defined in the catalog but is not connected to a live provider yet. Configuration and endpoints will appear here when the module is enabled.

RecaptchaIntegration.meta_description: Live Google reCAPTCHA v3 verification for forms and public endpoints.
RecaptchaIntegration.title: Google reCAPTCHA
RecaptchaIntegration.description: Bot protection with Google reCAPTCHA v3. The browser requests a token, then this application verifies it with Google and applies a minimum score threshold.

flow_steps.load: Load the Google reCAPTCHA script with the public site key.
flow_steps.execute: Call grecaptcha.execute with an action name to obtain a short-lived token.
flow_steps.verify: POST the token to /api/recaptcha/verify, which calls Google siteverify with the secret key.
flow_steps.score: Accept the request when success is true, the action matches, and the score meets the configured minimum.

RecaptchaIntegration.demo_description: Runs reCAPTCHA v3 and verifies the token through this application's API.
RecaptchaIntegration.setup_body: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY and RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY from the Google reCAPTCHA admin console, then restart the app to enable the live demo.
